contract.method: authored native behavior contract with independent JS reference
contract.description: Replace every nonoverlapping literal search inside the selected code-point window, then restore the unchanged prefix and suffix. Empty search leaves the window unchanged. Inserted text is not rescanned; dollar signs are literal.
contract.domain: Text arguments contain at most 64 Unicode code points each and no lone surrogate code units. Indices and lengths count code points, not UTF-16 units. Inputs are unchanged; returned arrays are fresh. Integer indices satisfy 0 <= start <= end <= text length.

inputRoles.start: inclusive first index of editable region
inputRoles.end: exclusive end index of editable region

contract.outputRole: original outer text with only the selected region edited
contract.mutationPolicy: Do not modify inputs; array outputs must be fresh with independent storage.

documentation: Native semantics reviewed against VeraCompiler.ets and VeraUi.ets. These tasks are not translated upstream symbols.
